name: tradingview
description: TradingView Desktop integration via CDP — real-time prices, DCF alerts, chart snapshots, portfolio sync, live order execution, chart control (add/remove indicators, timeframe, symbol, Data Window read), Pine Script v6 authoring (lint, inject, save to library), deep technical analysis, and daily batch TA sweep (/ta-daily-sweep) across all portfolio holdings. Custom indicator library at plugins/tradingview/assets/pinescript-indicators/.
